setup: Dropbox sign-in is not configured in this build. Configure Bmail's Dropbox app key before building.
auth: Dropbox access expired or was denied. Connect Dropbox again.
permission: Dropbox permissions are missing. Enable account_info.read, files.metadata.read, and files.content.write in the app console, allow public clients, then connect again.
credentials: Could not unlock Dropbox credentials. Connect again as this Windows user.
timeout: Dropbox sign-in timed out. Connect Dropbox again.
port: The Dropbox sign-in port is busy. Close the other sign-in window and retry.
network: Dropbox could not be reached. Check your connection and retry.
quota: Dropbox storage or request limits were reached. Free space or wait, then retry.
busy: A Dropbox operation is already running for this mailbox.
files: A saved email is missing or damaged. Repair the local backup before uploading.
archive: Back up this mailbox locally before uploading to Dropbox.
checksum: Dropbox did not confirm the uploaded file checksum. Retry cloud backup.
failed: Dropbox backup could not finish. Your local backups are safe. Retry cloud backup.
